rules: Do not synthesize staged_resolution when metadata.schema_version is 0.7.
Keep schema 0.7 source_impact records in their historical shape.
For schema 0.8, resolve each stage source_impact ID through staged_resolution.source_impact.
Treat top-level transition.package_changes and source_impact as direct-final evidence, not staged evidence.
Stop consuming recommended plan stages at the first unproved stage outcome.
